description: This Java class 'ActionBarNavigation' demonstrates implementing common navigation flows with the ActionBar in an Android application. It sets up an ActionBar with an 'up' affordance and handles button clicks to launch new activities.

classes.name: ActionBarNavigation
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating navigation with the ActionBar, including setting up the 'up' button and handling button clicks to launch other activities.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the ActionBar with the 'up' affordance, and updates a TextView based on how it was launched.

methods.name: onNewActivity
methods.description: Handles button click to launch a new instance of ActionBarNavigationTarget activity.

methods.name: onNewDocument
methods.description: Handles button click to launch ActionBarNavigationTarget in a new document task.
